attempts.prompt: High overhead map of a compact Japanese company island, north at the top, flat-shaded low-poly 3D with subtle surface patterns, small modelled details and soft daytime shadows. Wide landscape composition with the whole coastline visible and calm blue sea around it. At the left shore, a concrete monorail beam on piers meets a long navy station canopy beside a tall slate office tower with at least twelve floors; a short covered walkway joins the raised platform terrace directly to its pale glass entrance wing. A broad pedestrian street runs right through a central square containing a round shallow fountain and a clock pole, with a low blue-roofed canteen immediately above the square. To the upper right are a sage-roofed gym, a small sports court and three university wings around a courtyard; to the lower right are a short teal-awning shop row, a small charcoal bar and three pale apartment blocks around an asymmetric garden. Visible paths reach every building entrance. A waterfront path circles the seawall, with a service lane along the upper edge. Muted slate, pale concrete and green planting, clear cool daylight. No text or interface.
